_about: Where the House finds things. No secret is ever in this file: tokens come from the environment or the box's .env.

performance._about: The record's first point. start_equity was reset on Sept 19, 2026 (the owner's decision) to what the two real accounts held that afternoon, before the league's first real trade; the public chart draws start_equity plus the league's own real-money result.

jev._about: Jev as the cheap sensor (league/sensors.py). Caps are per UTC day across every purpose; the gateway's lifetime allowance stays the authority. Set enabled false to run the House exactly as before.

research_gate._about: after, max_factor and sample_percent are the v0 dials in game.json research.gate; game.json research.gate.enabled false turns every research gate off.
